# HealthReachCareCare

> Integrated healthcare management platform for South Africa — connecting patients, pharmacies, hospitals, and delivery drivers in one place.

HealthReachCareCare lets patients order medication from verified pharmacies, upload prescriptions, track deliveries in real time, manage medication reminders, and pay securely. Pharmacies manage inventory and fulfilment; hospitals issue digital prescriptions; drivers handle last-mile delivery.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of the HealthReachCareCare platform and roles it serves.
- [About](/about): Mission, vision, and the team behind HealthReachCareCare.
- [Contact](/contact): Get in touch with HealthReachCareCare support and sales.
- [Sign up](/signup): Create a patient, pharmacy, hospital, driver, or admin account.
- [Log in](/login): Sign in to your HealthReachCareCare dashboard.

## Optional
